title: RedactionConfig
description: Controls redaction behavior for exported run records and replay bundles.

redact_payloads.description: Whether action payloads should be replaced with redaction markers.

redact_targets.description: Whether action targets should be replaced.

redact_final_output.description: Whether final output should be replaced.

redact_reasons.description: Whether action and policy reasons should be replaced.

replacement.description: Replacement string used when redacting string fields.
